title: Reading pairs and dictionary entries
description: You can unpack list elements and choose defaults for missing dictionary keys.

steps.description: rules is a list of two tuples, each holding a name and pattern. You unpack the first tuple and print INT [0-9]+.
append adds a third rule, and rules[-1] selects it. The ages dictionary then maps ada to 36 and grace to 85.

steps.question: How do the two lookups for alan differ?
steps.answer: Both encounter a missing key. The first returns None, while the second returns its explicit default 0.

steps.description: You see None, 0 and True from the lookups and membership check. Iterating ages.items() prints ada 36 followed by grace 85.
